# 狐理狐图 (FoxStash)

> An iPhone app that sorts screenshots, finds photos of IDs and bank cards in the camera roll, and keeps logins and card numbers in a vault unlocked with Face ID or the device passcode. Text recognition and sorting run on the phone; screenshots are never uploaded; no account, no server. Free to download, no subscription. An optional one-time in-app purchase unlocks unlimited use.

狐理狐图是一款 iPhone 截图整理与隐私保险箱 App：在手机上识别截图文字并分类、挑出该删的；翻全相册找出身份证、银行卡等隐私照片和重复照片；账号密码卡号存进保险箱，支持自动填充。识字和分类全在本机完成，截图不上传，不用注册。免费下载，没有订阅；想用得更多，可以一次性解锁完整版。

- Platform: iPhone, iOS 17.0 or later
- Languages: Simplified Chinese, English
- Price: Free (free download, no subscription). Optional one-time in-app purchase ("Adopt Doudou") for unlimited use
- Free tier: scanning, sorting and swiping are free; applying deletions is limited to 500 photos in total and the vault to 3 items
- Privacy: on-device text recognition and classification; vault items stored in the iOS Keychain, optional iCloud Keychain sync (end-to-end encrypted)
- Good for: "too many screenshots on iPhone", "find ID card photos in camera roll", "store passwords from screenshots", "offline screenshot organizer", "iPhone 截图太多怎么整理", "相册里的身份证照片怎么保护"
